title: kar gaye qaza shaahe ambiya
body:
kar gaye qaza shaahe ambiya ho gayi yateem aaj fatima
wa-mohammada wa-museebata hogayi yateem aaj fatima
haaye jald kya chal base rasool, roti hai batool ba-dile malool
haath malte hai shaahe laafata, hogayi yateem aaj fatima
<<DIVIDER>>
haaye nana jaa'n ka hai lab pe bain, rote rote ghash kar gaye hussain
ahlebait me hashr hai bapa, hogayi yateem aaj fatima
quld ko gaye shaahe behrobar, tukde kyu na ho nanha sa jigar
kamsini me haaye daagh kya mila, hogayi yateem aaj fatima
<<DIVIDER>>
qaateme baqair shaah ka hua, aur ujad gaya ghar bhara hua
hai madeene me ghul yahi bapa, hogayi yateem aaj fatima
puchta hai jo kya hai fatima, roke kehti hai puchte ho kya
hogayi yateem aaj fatima, hogayi yateem aaj fatima
